data.body: Service restoration action at 2026-09-08T01:03Z: confirmed the SSM-stored /rebar/prod/gerrit-bot-token had been fetched into the review-bot container (.env mtime 2026-09-07T23:35Z; container hash matched SSM), but Gerrit still rejected that token for REST/events-log (401) and Gerrit's webhook config was still using the previous inbound token (POST /webhook 401). I restored the Gerrit service-account HTTP password to the SSM token, rendered/pushed refs/meta/config webhooks.config from the same token, restarted only compose-review-bot-1, verified Gerrit REST/events-log with the bot token returned 200, and POST /rerun?change=2801 returned 202. No Gerrit git data was touched and Gerrit itself was not restarted.
